title: Safety FollowUp Study Of Cardiovascular Events In Subjects Who Participated In Selected Torcetrapib/Atorvastatin Studies

sections.abstract: An observational safety follow up trial will be conducted to monitor the occurrence of cardiovascular events and all cause mortality in subjects who participated in selected torcetrapib/atorvastatin Phase 1, 2, and 3 clinical trials. No hypotheses will be tested.
